help.body: LightOps scans source folders, pairs JPG/RAW files by folder and filename stem, applies camera clock offsets, builds a rename plan from corrected capture time, then copies, moves, or renames files.

source.title: 1. Source
source.body: Choose one or more source folders and an optional output folder.

scan.title: 2. Scan
scan.body: Detect the first image in each source folder and equalize camera clocks.

rules.title: 3. Rules
rules.body: Review detected camera formats, choose file type, rename format, and advanced options.

review.title: 4. Review
review.body: Check every source folder, dry run, then execute when ready.

results.title: 5. Results
results.body: Review output as text or table after a dry run or execution.

about.title: LightOps
about.body: Desktop photo file manager for fast camera-card cleanup.
about.author: Author: Bao Le. LightOps is part of the baole.space tool family and uses the LightOps icon set from baole.space.
about.stack: The app is built with Tauri, Rust, React, and TypeScript. File operations run in Rust; the UI provides a keyboard-friendly workflow and native OS menus.
